AGREEMENT TO SELL
This Agreement to Sell is executed on 10/01/2023 at Harinagar.
Seller: Ramesh Chandra Verma, S/o Late Shyam Lal Verma.
Buyer: Anita Sharma, W/o Vinod Sharma.
Property Address: Plot No. 17, Block C, Lakshmi Nagar Extension. Khasra No. 245/2, total area

balance shall be paid at registration of the sale deed.
